The '''B0-2S Battle Droid''' was a [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] which went berserk on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] around [[3642 BBY]], when it was destroyed.

==Behind the scenes==
B0-2S Battle Droid appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as a Champion boss on Nar Shaddaa. It is not directly involved in any quests, but can be killed for loot and as part of the achievement. This article assumes 100% game completion, which means it was destroyed.
